summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (RegexHighlighter, base style "json.", one combined pattern for brace, true/false/null, number, str). rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* theme entries. rich/json.py (new) adds the JSON renderable (parses, serializes with indent, highlights via JSONHighlighter or NullHighlighter, sets no_wrap=True and overflow=None, stores Text in .text, __rich__ returns it) plus a __main__ CLI with soft_wrap printing and a stderr "Unable to read" error with exit -1. rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print, importing JSON lazily. rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json delegating to get_console(), not added to __all__. Docs: "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst before "Low level output", new docs/source/reference/json.rst, toctree entry in reference.rst. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added entry. Tests: new tests/test_print_json.py with a truecolor Console test asserting the exact styled sample output and a package-level test using a monkeypatched get_console. Caveats: nothing was executed, so the tests and the hand-derived ANSI expectations are unverified. I read overflow=None as the spec's "overflow to none".
